Read against the irw#1945 test, that clause RESERVES A RIGHT in two of the listed ways at once: it is non-commercial, and by implication permission-required for anything outside that scope. It is not a fitness disclaimer -- it says nothing about what the scale is good for, it conditions who may use it. Per the 2026-09-08 ruling, 'our own use is non-profit academic research, which the clause allows' is not a defence, because IRW redistributes and cannot condition a downstream user's commercial use.
